title: Stage path on touch devices: unit squares become 28x44 bars and capstone diamonds render as skewed slashes
detail: On iPad and iPhone (pointer: coarse) the desk hero's stage path (and every KOS.codeUI stage path) draws each unit square U1..U12 as a 28x44 tall rectangle and each capstone diamond as a 16x44 box rotated 45deg, which reads as a broken diagonal stroke rather than a diamond. Mac (fine pointer) is correct. Reproduce: #/subject/code at ipad/iphone.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-ipad.png, audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-iphone.png; eval at iphone: .k-cx-dia offsetWidth 16 x offsetHeight 44 with transform rotate(45deg); .k-cx-sq 28x44. css/base.css:115-119 (coarse min-block-size: var(--hit-coarse) on every button) vs css/views/code.css:132,137 (fixed inline-size/block-size), buttons made at js/core/codeui.js:556,567
rootCause: The global coarse-pointer rule raises min-block-size of every <button> to 44px (invariant 69) but the path's square/diamond buttons only set inline-size/block-size, so height grows and width does not; the diamond is then rotated.
fix: Give .k-cx-sq and .k-cx-dia min-block-size: 0 (they are visual marks; the diamond is tabindex -1) and put the 44px hit area on a transparent ::before or wrapper, or raise width with height for the squares (invariant 69: a round/square control must raise its width too).

title: iPhone desk: Daily 20 and Continue squeezed side by side; the Open-lesson button's label spills out of its pill
detail: At 402px the desk's side column (.k-subj-side) switches to a row, so Daily 20 and Continue are each ~180px wide. The Daily 20 body wraps to five lines, and the 'Open 1.1 Your first program' button is nowrap: its text (153px) overflows the 144px pill on both sides, so the label crosses the button border. Continue is a tall card with its content floating in the middle of ~200px of empty space, and its title wraps.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-iphone-d20.png (dpr 2), audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-iphone.png; eval iphone: [data-ui=code.daily20-lesson] 144x44, scrollWidth 153, white-space nowrap; .k-cx-d20 width 180. css/views/study.css:1074-1076 (side becomes a row of flex:1 1 0 cards), button at js/modules/code.js:221-223
rootCause: The phone/compact rule lays the side column as a row of two equal cards whatever their width; k-btn is nowrap with no max-inline-size or ellipsis, and the label names the lesson in full.
fix: Under 560px stack the two side cards (flex-direction: column) or fold Continue into the Daily 20 card when the Daily 20's job is 'Finish 1.1 first' (they point at the same lesson). Shorten the button to 'Open 1.1' or allow wrapping/ellipsis (.k-fit-btn).

title: Stage path scroller clips the current unit's square and its focus ring at its left edge
detail: On iPhone the first square U1 (state current, with a 2-ring box-shadow) starts exactly at the scroller's left edge (both x=34), so the outer ring and the square's left border are cut off.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-iphone-d20.png; eval iphone: U1 left 34 = scroller left 34. css/views/code.css:134 (ring drawn by box-shadow outside the box)
rootCause: The scroller has no inline padding to hold the box-shadow ring of the first/last item.
fix: Give the path row padding-inline of 2*focus-width (or scroll-padding) so the ring is inside the clip.

title: Desk side column: a real Daily 20 task crushes the Continue card to 41px and clips its 'CONTINUE' label (Mac, iPad landscape)
detail: With a task in the Daily 20 (tier pill, title, three concept chips wrapping to two rows, the why line, Start), the Daily 20 card grows to 239px of the side column's fixed 292px (the hero's height). The Continue card gets 41px while its content needs 62px; overflow: hidden cuts the CONTINUE kicker in half under the Daily 20 card's border. Same at iPad landscape (d20 327 of 459, Continue 121, fits) and worse whenever the why line wraps to three lines. The concept chips (k-cx-cchips) wrap one per row on narrow cards, adding rows.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-prog-mac.png (CONTINUE at y~396 cut); eval mac: .k-cx-d20 239px tall, [data-ui=study.continue] clientHeight 41 vs scrollHeight 62; side 292 = hero 292. css/views/study.css:50 (.k-subj-side > :first-child flex: 1 1 auto), :54 (contain: size), :55 (> * { min-block-size: 0; overflow: hidden }); js/modules/code.js:124, 228-234, 51-55
rootCause: The side column is size-contained to the hero's height and its children may shrink to zero with overflow hidden; the Daily 20 card (first child, flex 1 1 auto) takes what it needs, so the second card is what gives way and is clipped rather than the layout growing.
fix: Give the Continue card flex: 0 0 auto (never shrink below its content) and let the Daily 20 card scroll/clip instead, or drop size containment when the content is taller than the hero; render concept chips as one non-wrapping scroller or limit to two chips + '+1'.

title: Subject analytics card stretches its eight tiles over the Retrieval-due list's height, leaving ~120px gaps between rows
detail: On the Code desk the analytics card (k-sa) is in a row with Retrieval due. With 4+ due skills the row is 412px tall and the grid (flex 1 1 0, grid-auto-rows 1fr, tiles justify-content center) spreads two rows of figures across it: Mastery/Lessons at y~560, Skills proven/Tasks passed at y~740, mostly empty dark card between. On iPad portrait (empty account) the 8 tiles stack 2 per row over ~450px, five of them showing only a dash. Conversely with nothing due the Retrieval-due card is a 250px card holding one sentence.
rootCause: grid-auto-rows: 1fr with flex: 1 1 0 makes the tile rows absorb whatever height the neighbouring card imposes; tiles centre their content vertically.
fix: Size the grid to its content (grid-auto-rows: auto, align-content: start) and let the Retrieval-due list cap/scroll, or put the shorter column on sticky ride-along (the Reports pack rule). On narrow widths use 4 columns of compact tiles or hide zero/dash tiles (invariant 77).

title: Continue keeps pointing at 1.1 after the learner has worked through 22 lessons
detail: KOS.code.stats().current is the first core lesson whose status is not 'done'. Completed needs all four checks, and the fourth (a retrieval passed) cannot be earned until the card's first review comes due days later. So after reading every page, running every listing and passing every task in lessons 1.1-3.5 (and starting 3.6), the desk's Continue card still says '1.1 Your first program' at 75%, and the hero's current unit ring stays on U1. The learner's real place (3.6) is nowhere on the desk.
evidence: eval after marking pages/listings/tasks for 22 lessons: stats().current.ref = '1.1', evidence('1.1').checks = [true,true,true,false]; audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-prog-mac.png (Continue 1.1). js/core/code.js:870 (current = first not done), js/modules/code.js:250-262
rootCause: 'Where to continue' is derived from completion (which includes a time-gated retrieval) instead of coverage (KOS.code.studied) or the last lesson touched.
fix: Continue at the first lesson not yet studied (KOS.code.studied false), or the most recently touched unfinished lesson; leave pending retrievals to the Retrieval card.

title: Task Run can only feed ONE line of input: a correct answer to any multi-line task crashes with ArgumentNullException
detail: The task page's STDIN box is a single-line <input type=text>, prefilled with only the first line of the first example (split('\n')[0]). 158 of 258 tasks have multi-line example input. Pressing Run with the reference answer to 2.9 Guessing game (example input 42/50/30/42) gives 'Runtime exception ArgumentNullException line 5 Value cannot be null', because the second Console.ReadLine() returns null. A learner can never try their program on the example before Check, and the error points at correct code, which teaches the wrong lesson.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/task-run-multiline-mac.png; eval: set editor to KOS.code.task('2.9-guess').answer, click Run -> output 'ArgumentNullException line 5'; Object.values(KOS_CODE.TASKS) with multi-line examples[0].stdin = 158. js/modules/code.js:633-635 (input type text, split first line), :694 (stdin: stdin.value)
rootCause: Run's input was built as a one-line text field and deliberately truncates the example to its first line; an <input> cannot hold newlines.
fix: Use an auto-growing <textarea> (rows = example line count) prefilled with the whole first example stdin; keep Ctrl+Enter to run. Optionally a menu to load example N.

title: Retrieval's 'Next reviews will ask…' dates come from a hard-coded SM-2 formula and contradict the real FSRS schedule
detail: Under a card the page projects its next three reviews as 'in 3 days / in 11 days / in 31 days', computed with ivl*2.5 (SM-2). Answering the card first try (graded Easy by FSRS) shows 'Proven · Easy · next in 8 days' directly above a table still saying 'in 3 days'. Since 20 October every card is scheduled by KOS.fsrs (invariant 111); the projection is invented and never matches. The page subtitle also keeps '6 due today' after the tab count dropped to 5.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/retrieval-after-check-mac.png (next in 8 days vs table in 3 days); js/modules/code.js:1013-1020 (var ivl = Math.max(3, row.ivl||2), ef = 2.5 … ivl*ef)
rootCause: The projection predates the FSRS switch and was not moved to KOS.fsrs; it is not redrawn after a rating.
fix: Project with KOS.fsrs (Good each time from the card's current s/d with KOS.srs.weights() and the retention) or drop the dates and keep only the variation list; redraw after finish().

title: Capstone step bar: steps 2-6 are 26x40 targets on iPhone and every step is 40px tall on iPad
detail: The capstone's six-step bar (Closed-book quiz, Brief & build, Rubric, Kurenai review, Write-up, Result) collapses the inactive steps to number circles on iPhone: each button is 26x40, under the 44px touch minimum in both directions, and the circles sit 4px apart. On iPad every step is 40px tall (75x40 for inactive ones).
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/capstone-C1-iphone.png; DOM measurement iphone: k-cx-step 26x40 (x5), ipad 75x40. css/views/code.css:505 (.k-cx-step min-block-size: var(--sp-40)) — a class rule that beats the zero-specificity coarse rule in css/base.css:115-119
rootCause: The step's own min-block-size (40px) overrides the global touch minimum and no coarse-pointer tier raises it; compact steps have no min-inline-size.
fix: Under (pointer: coarse) give .k-cx-step min-block-size and min-inline-size var(--hit-coarse) (circles stay drawn at 26px inside the 44px button).

title: On iPhone every Code sub-page loses its own title: a task, a track, the skill map, katas and settings all read just 'Code'
detail: The phone title bar takes the current subject pill's label ('Code') and the page's own heading (.k-pagehead-txt) is hidden. So #/code/task/2.9-guess shows 'Code' and a statement with no task name or tier; #/code/track/T1 shows 'Code' over an Overview card with no 'T1 · Connectivity and persistence'; Skill map, Curriculum map, Katas, Settings and Rider projects likewise. Nothing on screen says where you are, and there is no back/breadcrumb on the task page.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/task-2.9-guess-iphone.png, audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/track-T1-iphone.png; eval iphone on #/code/task/2.9-guess: h1.k-ptitle-h 'Code' visible, .k-pagehead (with h1 'Guessing game') display:none. js/modules/mobile-shell.js:551 (title = data-phone-title-text || cur.label || h1), css/components.css:651-652
rootCause: syncTitleBar prefers the current destination's label over the page's own h1; Code's sub-pages are all under the 'Code' destination and set no [data-phone-title-text].
fix: In Code's pages mark the page title with data-phone-title-text (or make syncTitleBar prefer the page h1 when the view has a sub-page arg), keeping the kicker 'Code · task' as the bar's section line.

title: Phone 'Best on a computer' task shows the example OUTPUT without its input
detail: On iPhone a later task (e.g. 2.9 Guessing game) is shown read-only to save for the computer. Its example box shows 'Example output: Lower / Higher / Correct in 3 guesses' but not the input 42/50/30/42 that produces it, so the example cannot be understood. The box is also half-width beside nothing.
rootCause: phoneLater renders only the out half of the example.
fix: Render the same two-column Input/Output example as the desktop task panel, full width.

title: Rider project's 'Lessons it proves' is string-sorted: 10.1, 10.10, 10.2, 10.3 …
detail: On #/code/project/rp-u10-library the side card lists '10.1 Why test, 10.10 Practise: test a legacy module, 10.2 xUnit …' — 10.10 sits second. Same for any project whose lessons pass .9 (and T1.10+ in tracks).
rootCause: Array.prototype.sort with no comparator on dotted refs.
fix: Sort by the lesson's spine index (C().lesson(r).idx) or a numeric dotted comparator.

title: Lesson listings' Run / Reset / Copy are 33px tall on iPad and iPhone
detail: Every runnable listing in a Code lesson has Run, Reset and Copy buttons 64x33, 61x33 and 59x33 on touch devices (the most-pressed control in a lesson). On iPad, the topic page reports 15 sub-44px targets; the reader's page select is 274x30.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/topic-1.1-iphone.png; eval iphone: [data-ui=code.listing-run] height 33.25; DOM measurement ipad #/ref/code/1.1. css/views/code.css:152 (.k-cx-listing .k-ced-head .k-btn { min-block-size: var(--hit-dense) }) overrides css/components.css:678
rootCause: A dense override for the listing head with no (pointer: coarse) tier; specificity beats the coarse .k-btn rule.
fix: Wrap code.css:152 in @media (pointer: fine) or add a coarse tier restoring var(--hit-coarse).

title: iPad portrait: 'Start focus' wraps to its own 44px row and the subject pills cut 'Creatives' down to a lone dot
detail: At 820px the stage head (subject pills + Code's section links + Start focus) does not fit one line: Start focus wraps alone onto a second row at the right (≈64px of mostly empty band above the hero), while the subject pill scroller is clipped so only Creatives' yellow dot shows at its right edge with no label or scroll affordance. Same chrome on every Code page (map, skills, retrieval, kata, settings, track).
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-prog-ipad.png, audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/desk-empty-ipad.png; eval ipad: Start focus at top 138 in .k-page-actions row of 44px below the nav row. css/layout.css:346 (.k-stage-head flex-wrap: wrap), :349; js/modules/code.js:89-91
rootCause: The stage head wraps rather than compacting; #subnav (subject pills + 4 Code links) is wider than 820 minus the button, and the pill scroller has no fade/arrow at that width.
fix: At ≤860 move Start focus into the hero (or make it an icon button), or put Code's four links in a second compact row; give the pill strip a declared KOS.ui.scroller with edge arrows so a partial pill is never shown as a bare dot.

title: After a task passes the page offers no next step and its clock keeps running
detail: Passing 2.9 Guessing game (4 of 4, +26 XP) leaves the page as it was: no 'Next task', 'Back to the desk' or 'Next in the Daily 20' action beside the reward line, so the only way on is the breadcrumb. The task clock in the header keeps counting (00:47 → 00:50 three seconds later) after every test passed.
evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/code-space/task-checked-mac.png; eval: header time 00:47 then 00:50 after pass
rootCause: The pass handler writes the reward line but does not stop the task timer or render a forward action.
fix: On a proven pass stop the clock (show the time taken) and add a primary 'Next' (the next task of the lesson, or back to the Daily 20/desk).

title: Daily 20 marked Done still says 'you haven't proven Input loops in code yet'
detail: After the Daily 20 task passes, the desk card shows '✓ Done today · +26 XP' under the unchanged why line 'You studied 2.9 and haven't proven Input loops in code yet.', which is now false.
evidence: eval #/subject/code .k-cx-d20 innerText after passing 2.9-guess; js/modules/code.js:234-240 (why printed whatever plan.done)
rootCause: planDay's why is computed for the morning pick and printed even when done.
fix: When plan.done, replace the why with what was proven ('Proven today: Input loops, while, Ternary').
